title: Vietnamese Banh Xeo
description: A crispy Vietnamese pancake filled with pork and served with fresh herbs. This dish is perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the taro starch and water to form a batter.
Add the ground pork, shrimp, bean sprouts, and fresh herbs to the batter and mix well.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the pan and swirl it around.
Pour a small amount of the batter into the pan and tilt the pan to form a round shape.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is crispy and golden brown.
Flip the pancake and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is crispy and golden brown.
Serve the pancake with fried shallots, coconut milk, fish sauce, and soy sauce.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve immediately.
